title: Decision JM-4: minimal JMAP Chat core on the provider
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 (5630c10) with base JMAP Chat. The provider serves: Session, /jmap/api, EventSource (no WSS, no PushSubscription); Chat/get,changes,query; Message/get,changes,query (filter chatId only; queryChanges -> cannotCalculateChanges); ChatContact/get,changes for hub contacts. Chat/set: create, destroy and every update forbidden (the draft requires only its listed keys; refusing more is a Limitation). Message/set: create and body/bodyType/reactions updates -> invalidArguments (draft); other updates and destroy -> forbidden (Limitation). No ChatContact/set, so blocked is always false (Limitation). text/plain advertised (core MUST) but never accepted.
notes:
2026-10-18 corrections: (a) KNOWN NONCONFORMANCE, not core-compliant: base JMAP Chat L245 defines supportedBodyTypes as the MIME types accepted in bodyType and says it MUST include text/plain; the provider advertises text/plain but rejects it, since every Chat is roomed. Proposed draft exemption for encrypted-only deployments: jmap-chat-spec-mmcb (pending Mark). (b) Multi-device state: mimid-1wgh.12.29. (c) WSS: mimid-1wgh.12.30 supersedes .9.
Widened 2026-10-18 (Mark, audit item 3), base draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 at jmap-chat-spec 5630c10. Further recorded nonconformances: (a) Chat/set per-user updates L1021 (muted, muteUntil, receiveTypingIndicators, messageExpirySeconds, receiptSharing) refused, follows .12.29; (b) ChatContact/set update of blocked/displayName L967-969 not offered, so blocking the hub (mimi-00 L424) is unavailable; (c) ReadPosition L906, L1333-1347 absent, follows .12.29; (d) application/mimi-fanout advertised (mimi-00 L156) but rejected on create (mimi-00 L415), vs base L245 'accepted in bodyType'. Asked crate-jmap-50 whether mmcb's L245 rewording also covers (d).
2026-10-18 crate-jmap-50: mmcb does NOT cover (d). Fix proposed as jmap-chat-spec-wq4x (awaiting Mark): L245 -> types a Message bodyType can take on this account; server MUST accept every listed type in Message/set create except types a companion spec reserves for server-created Messages. Dropping mimi L156 fails because base L612 requires bodyType in supportedBodyTypes. Keep (d) until Mark decides and the commit exists.
2026-10-18 crate-jmap-50: Mark approved jmap-chat-spec-wq4x; lands with mmcb as one L245 edit (not committed yet). Retire (d) and the text/plain item when the hash arrives.
RETIRED 2026-10-18 against jmap-chat-spec cefc217 (pushed): base L245 now 'The MIME types a Message bodyType can take on this account. The server MUST accept in Message/set create every listed type except types a companion specification reserves for server-created Messages. MUST include text/plain unless the server accepts only end-to-end encrypted body types'; mimi-00 L430 'Only servers create such Messages'. So (d) mimi-fanout is conformant, and the provider drops text/plain from supportedBodyTypes (it accepts only E2EE types). Remaining nonconformances (a)-(c) stand.
